manual.description: The app calls this with ?role=&branch=&zone= . A GET with no custom headers is a simple request, so there is no CORS preflight.

Build_filter.inputs: @if(equals(coalesce(triggerOutputs()['queries']?['role'],''),'admin'), '', if(equals(coalesce(triggerOutputs()['queries']?['role'],''),'regional'), concat('EngineerZone eq ''', coalesce(triggerOutputs()['queries']?['zone'],''), ''''), if(equals(coalesce(triggerOutputs()['queries']?['role'],''),'branch'), concat('EngineerBranch eq ''', coalesce(triggerOutputs()['queries']?['branch'],''), ''''), concat('EngineerCode eq ''', coalesce(triggerOutputs()['queries']?['userId'],''), ''''))))
Build_filter.description: HO Admin sees every zone, a Regional Manager their own zone, a Branch Official their own branch, a Field Engineer only their own surveys. The app sends role, userId, branch and zone on the query string; the app applies the same rule again on what comes back.

Select_payloads.description: RawPayload is the whole survey as the app sent it, so the app can rebuild the full report from it.

Respond_to_the_app.description: The Access-Control-Allow-Origin header is required or the browser will not let the page read this reply.

Respond_when_it_fails.description: Without this the app waits for a reply that never comes when the list read fails.
